newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares, technology stocks recover.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares, technology stocks recover.

text.p: Nasdaq shares recovered on Wednesday, helped by gains in the Dow industrials, which powered to their fourth consecutive all-time high.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 6.15 points or 0.44 percent to 1407.84. Nasdaq shares dropped slightly at the opening and slipped to a low of 1394.44, but moved in to positive territory late in the day on strength in technology issues, traders said.
Advancing issues nearly matched decliners, 2112 to 2160, on total volume of 630 million shares.

Intel Corp firmed 2-5/16 to 147-1/2, Microsoft Corp added 2-3/16 to 127 and 3Com Corp increased 2-2/16 to 47-9/16. Shareholders of 3Com and U.S. Robotics Corp approved the merger of the two networking firms, which is expected to close on June 11.

Some semiconductor equipment companies also recovered after Tuesday's losses despite mixed sentiment among brokerage firms. Two firms reiterated bullish comments on the sector, while Alex. Brown & Sons downgraded certain stocks such as Applied Materials Inc and KLA-Tencor Corp.
Small capitalization stocks held firm, with the Russell 2000 index gaining 0.08 percent to 387.62.
